meta.name: Picturelogue ～Escape From Oogiri Labyrinth～
meta.description: Contestants race to escape a mind-bending maze in 90 minutes, using their wit to caption photos and teaming up with partners for physical challenges.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Four comedians tackle a maze of comedy challenges alongside athletic partners, with just 90 minutes to find the way out.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Ryuji Akiyama and Takahiro Ogata take on Eiko Kano and Musashi, but one room's photo prompt arrives in a way nobody expects.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: After escaping the maze, Ryuji Akiyama and Takahiro Ogata go up against Eiko Kano and Musashi in a photo-caption duel to reach the final round.
